Dear Ms. Blamires,

Bestest Fitness has been providing our members the best environment for more than 15 years. Now, we have approximately 60,000 members all over Australia and we are very proud to say that our program is perfectly designed to fulfill our members' needs on a daily basis.

Our experienced and qualified instructors can give you advice on the best fitness program by having a counseling session. And if you want to lose weight in a healthy manner, we are willing to help you find the best way to work out and slim down. We have also arranged excellent and safe exercise programs for kids and the disabled.

For more details, please see the enclosed brochure. If you have any questions, leave us an e-mail message at information(a)bestest.com at any time, or you can contact us toll-free call (1-800-551-7790) during our business hours.

Sincerely,

Richards Grant

Manager

childQuestions.questionText: What can be inferred about Ms. Blamires?
options: (B) She is a member of Bestest Fitness.
(D) She sent a letter of complaint.

In addition, there is information "For more details, please see the enclosed brochure. If you have any questions, leave us an e-mail message at information(a)bestest.com" => A is correct

=> Có thể suy ra rằng cô Blamires đã hỏi một số thông tin về Bestest Fitness cũng như chương trình thể hình của nó. Ngoài ra còn có thông tin "Để biết thêm chi tiết, vui lòng xem tài liệu đính kèm. Nếu bạn có thắc mắc, hãy để lại email cho chúng tôi tại info(a)bestest.com" => A đúng

cards.questionText:
To: Petrisha Deaze<petrisha9@financialconsult.com>

From: Steven Hernandez<merrysteven@atcmulti.com>

Re: Phone conversation

Date: Monday, October 26

Dear Ms. Deaze,

I am writing to you to apologize for the inconvenience we had on the telephone just before. As you noticed, the conference call switch on my phone was acting up and several outside conversations interrupted us. I’m afraid that we may have lost or miscommunicated some important information at the end of conversation.

I know that you were talking about the value of the WebWide and IntelCom stocks we inquired about three days ago. However, I could not hear any more than that.

Our phones are still acting strange, so if it is possible, would you please fax me the information today? I would very much appreciate it.

Sincerely,

Steven Hernandez

_______________________________________________

To: Steven Hemandez<merrysteven@atcmulti.com>

From: Petrisha Deaze<petrisha9@financialconsult.com>

Date: October 26

Re: Phone conversation and correction

Dear Mr. Hernandez,

Thank you for your e-mail. It is true our communication did not go as smoothly as I had hoped during our call, but please do not worry about it. I understand that office equipment does break down at inconvenient times.

I called to inform you that two of the stock prices I faxed you last Friday were inaccurate. WebWide should be 1150.5 not 1155.5 and IntelCom should be 930.25 not 935.25.

I should have faxed the corrected data, but, unfortunately, our fax machine broke down yesterday morning and the replacement ordered hasn’t arrived yet. We both happened to have technical problems in our offices.

If you have any questions, please contact me anytime at the above e-mail address or by fax after Wednesday, the 28th. Once again, thank you for your concern.

Sincerely yours,

Petrisha Deaze

(B) To explain why his fax didn’t arrive

childQuestions.questionText: In the second e-mail, the word “concern” in paragraph 4, line 2, is closest in meaning to
childQuestions.transcript:
(A) worry: the state of worrying about something

(B) insecurity: a lack of confidence about yourself or your relationships with other people

(C) interest: the feeling that you have when you want to know or learn more about somebody/something

(D) anxiety: the state of feeling nervous or worried that something bad is going to happen

Based on the meaning of the word => Choose C
childQuestions.explanationVi:
Trong e-mail thứ hai, từ “concern” ở đoạn 4, dòng 2, gần nghĩa nhất với:

(A) worry: lo lắng

(B) insecurity: bất an

(C) interest: quan tâm

(D) anxiety: lo lắng

concern: bận tâm, quan tâm = interest

=> chọn C

childQuestions.questionText: When did Ms. Deaze fax Mr. Hernandez the wrong information?
childQuestions.transcript: In the second e-mail, there is information "I called to inform you that two of the stock prices I faxed you last Friday were inaccurate." Meanwhile, look at the first e-mail, we can see that the e-mail was sent on Monday, October 26. => Last Friday was October 23. => A is correct
childQuestions.explanationVi: Trong e-mail thứ hai có thông tin "I called to inform you that two of the stock prices I faxed you last Friday were inaccurate." nghĩa là "Tôi gọi điện để thông báo với bạn rằng hai giá cổ phiếu mà tôi đã fax cho bạn vào thứ Sáu tuần trước là không chính xác." Trong khi đó, nhìn vào e-mail đầu tiên, chúng ta có thể thấy e-mail được gửi vào thứ Hai, ngày 26 tháng 10. => Thứ Sáu tuần trước là ngày 23 tháng 10. => A đúng
